name: bnull-value-test-edd6349666/null-value-semantics-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Expressions: "Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only"; "List constructor"; "Relational expression"; "Nested expressions (`(expression)`)"
reason: The case checks rejection of nil assigned to non-nullable scalar, union, map, recursive array union, array element, tuple element and record types, and invalid nil arithmetic/comparison. These are negative type checks using supported declarations, literals, constructors and operators; subset10 specifies no applicable exclusion. The nullable parameter/call/return and json nil initialization also use supported constructs.
test_design_notes: The asserted behavior is compile-time rejection at @error markers; there are no @args, @panic or @output assertions.
Unmarked nullable string calls and json null initialization must remain valid.
